package: JanOS 1.7.0 + WARDRIVING SOLO for WDGWars GO 0.9.20

provenance.distribution: compiled application image, source patch and exact build configuration; no device dump

target.write_scope: application only; preserve bootloader, partition table, OTA selection, NVS, PHY and other app slot

validation.vendor_build_result: existing ESP-IDF 6.0.1 compilation, linking and partition-size checks passed; exact source/patch hashes reverified for release
validation.physical_scope: previously verified on one XIAO ESP32-C5 revision1.0 inside a CM5 uConsole; all five SOLO profiles, real Wi-Fi/BLE observations, STOP/ownership, durable host records, GPS fix/cache/startup-backfill observed
limitations: No WROOM vendor build or hardware validation for this image.
Linux/AC1200 software bridge does not implement this SOLO contract; legacy supported scan functions remain available.
No release-time physical flash; the tested image was preserved unchanged.
No independent RF measurement of every channel dwell or claim of RF losslessness.
No physical twelve-hour cache-boundary test or complete moving field-track test.
An intermittent USB enumeration failure occurred during prior testing; cause and universal cold-start recovery are not established.
The stock ESP32 FLASH wizard downloads upstream JanOS and is not a SOLO installer.
Rebuild timestamps, paths and host toolchain details can change binary identity; a rebuild is not automatically the tested image.
